definitions.gloss: one line, one streak, one strand
definitions.explanation: A single thin line or strand of something, such as light, smoke, tears, or hair.
Complete devotion to one path, pursuit, or person without wavering. Often used to describe lifelong dedication.

examples.japanese: ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一筋|ひとすじ}⟦{流|なが}れた→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
⟦{暗闇|くらやみ}→暗闇：12859_kurayami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一筋|ひとすじ}⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}んだ→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧。
examples.english: A single ray of light shone into the darkness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{煙突|えんとつ}→煙突：02271_entotsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一筋|ひとすじ}⟦{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}っていた→立ち上る：10670_tachinoboru⟧。
examples.english: A single trail of smoke was rising from the chimney.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧{一筋|ひとすじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きて→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧きた。
examples.english: I've devoted my whole life to cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧{一筋|ひとすじ}で、⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五十年間|ごじゅうねんかん}、⟦{大工|だいく}→大工：04051_daiku⟧{一筋|ひとすじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧きた⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧だ。
examples.english: My grandfather is a craftsman who has been devoted to carpentry for fifty years.

notes:
{一筋|ひとすじ} has two distinct uses: as a counter-like noun for thin line-shaped things, and as an expression of single-minded devotion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
Sense 1:
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一筋|ひとすじ} (a single tear)
- ⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一筋|ひとすじ} (a ray of light)
- ⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一筋|ひとすじ} (a trail of smoke)
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一筋|ひとすじ} (a glimmer of hope)

Sense 2:
- 〜{一筋|ひとすじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧ (live devoted to ~)
- 〜{一筋|ひとすじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧きた (have been devoted to ~ all along)
- {一筋|ひとすじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (a single path, unswerving dedication)

USAGE:
- In sense 2, {一筋|ひとすじ} often follows the noun it modifies directly: ⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧{一筋|ひとすじ} (devoted to baseball)
- ⟦{一筋縄|ひとすじなわ}ではいかない→一筋縄ではいかない：21294_hitosujinawadehaikanai⟧ is a set expression meaning "not straightforward" or "not easy to deal with"
